changes.title: Challenge statues
items: The challenge circle's animals stand as grey stone statues by their columns until you step onto its stone floor
Step in and they glow red for four bars, then wake as a wild pack on the beat
Once awake they chase you anywhere; fly off over the treetops outside the challenge area, or get knocked down, and the ones you haven't won go back to their posts as stone, fully healed
The challenge circle's carved sigil follows the fight: faint moonlight while the statues sleep, red as they wake, cold blue in the fight, warm once they're all won
The challenge circle's stone floor catches a little more moonlight, so you can see it before you step in
Animals you've won over wander their area out of the way of your fights until the spell is cast
The music spell's analyser fills the whole challenge circle as you cast it

changes.title: Challenge edge
items: The challenge circle now sits out on the island's edge, in its far half from home, and the ley line goes round it instead of running over it

changes.title: Telephone stall watchdog
items: Calls check the connection again after a pause in the game.

changes.title: Telephone relay
items: Telephone calls now use the dedicated Witch server.

changes.title: Telephone close recovery
items: A dropped telephone connection keeps your visit while it tries to reconnect.

changes.title: Guest bed hold
items: Holding the bed button works reliably when visiting a friend.

changes.title: Telephone reconnect
items: Telephone calls try to reconnect for 20 seconds, showing a countdown before the call ends.

changes.title: Guest wake inputs
items: A friend's movement stays in order when she gets out of bed.

changes.title: Guest takeoff prediction
items: Your witch keeps moving smoothly when leaving your friend's treehouse.

changes.title: Big pack
items: When you fly up out of a hunting pack's reach, it keeps circling round under you as it does while waiting its turn, instead of freezing in a heap
Big packs (more than 20 animals on you) attack in quicker rounds, the bigger the quicker
In big packs the animals whose turn is coming leave the circle early, so they're ready to attack when their turn starts
The biggest packs wait for their turn in rings round you and attack about as often as a pack of 20
